title: Differential Amplifiers
intro: Differential circuits dominate analog design because they reject common-mode noise and distortion. This chapter builds the differential pair from its qualitative idea to its quantitative gain and CMRR.

items: Differential pair: how the tail current is steered, gm and gain.
Common-mode response: tail impedance, mismatch and CMRR.
MOS loads and the Gilbert cell.
